deals.headline: Tredence Raises $175 Mn in Series B Funding from Advent International
deals.summary: Data science and AI services firm Tredence raised a $175 million Series B from Advent, which took a minority stake.
deals.evidence: SAN JOSE | BOSTON | BANGALORE | MUMBAI – December 22, 2022 – Tredence, the Data Science and AI Solutions company, today announced it has raised USD 175 million in Series B funding from Advent International (“Advent”) to accelerate data-fueled growth and AI value realization for industries. Advent will acquire a minority stake in Tredence with the $175 million investment.

deals.headline: Advent International to acquire a significant stake in Suven Pharmaceuticals from the Jasti family
deals.summary: Advent agreed to buy a significant stake in Suven Pharmaceuticals from the Jasti family, plus an open offer for a further 26%, with a view to merging it with Cohance Lifesciences.
deals.evidence: Mumbai, India, December 26, 2022: Advent International (“Advent”), one of the largest and most experienced global private equity investors, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire significant stake in Suven Pharmaceuticals (“Suven Pharma” or “Suven”) from the Jasti family, subject to regulatory approvals and conditions. As part of the transaction, Advent will also be making an open offer to acquire additional 26% of the outstanding equity shares of the company from the public shareholders.

deals.headline: Kerry to sell its Sweet Ingredients Portfolio to Advent International’s portfolio company, IRCA
deals.summary: Advent's portfolio company IRCA entered exclusive negotiations to buy Kerry's Sweet Ingredients Portfolio for EUR 500m.
deals.evidence: 11 January 2023-Kerry Group plc today announces that it has entered into exclusive negotiations to sell the trade and assets of its Sweet Ingredients Portfolio to IRCA (“the Potential Sale”), an international leader in chocolate, creams, and other high-quality semi-finished food ingredients, for a consideration of 500m1. The consideration of €500m comprises an initial cash consideration of €375m (subject to routine closing adjustments) plus a €125m interest bearing vendor loan note. ↩︎

deals.headline: Boasso Global and Quala to Merge, Creating a Leading Infrastructure Service Provider for Liquid Bulk Logistics Industry
deals.summary: KKR-owned Boasso Global agreed to merge with Quala, buying Advent's shares as part of the combination.
deals.evidence: Under the terms of the agreement, KKR will inject further growth capital into Boasso to facilitate the merger with Quala via a purchase of shares from Advent International (“Advent”) and invest in the strategic combination of the two businesses.

deals.headline: Advent International invests in LBS Group, a leading pest control operation and hygiene solutions provider in Greater China
deals.summary: Advent invested in LBS Group, a pest control and hygiene services provider in Greater China.
deals.evidence: Shanghai, 23 February 2023 – Advent International (“Advent”), one of the world’s largest and most experienced private equity investors, today announced that it has invested in LBS Group (“LBS”), a leading pest control operation (PCO) and hygiene solutions provider in Greater China.

deals.headline: Advent International agrees to sell Tag, a leading global marketing production company, to dentsu
deals.summary: Advent agreed to sell marketing production company Tag to Dentsu.
deals.evidence: London, 7 March 2023 – Advent International (“Advent”), one of the world’s largest and most experienced private equity investors, has entered into an agreement to sell Tag, a leading global omnichannel marketing production company, to Dentsu Group Inc. (Tokyo: 4324; ISIN: JP3551520004), one of world’s largest global marketing and advertising agency networks.

deals.headline: Envalior enters the engineering materials market as a new global leader
deals.summary: Envalior launched as a joint venture combining DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials under Advent and LANXESS ownership.
deals.evidence: Envalior emerges from the combination of two highly complementary industry leaders in engineering materials – DSM Engineering Materials (DEM) and LANXESS High Performance Materials (HPM) – under the ownership of global private equity firm Advent International and specialty chemicals company LANXESS.

deals.headline: U.S. private equity firm Advent International and BCI complete acquisition of Maxar Technologies
deals.summary: Advent, with minority investor BCI, completed the take-private of Maxar Technologies at $53.00 per share.
deals.evidence: On December 16, 2022, Advent and Maxar announced that they had entered into a definitive merger agreement under which all outstanding shares of Maxar common stock would be acquired for $53.00 per share in cash, valuing Maxar at approximately $6.4 billion.

deals.headline: Baxter signs definitive agreement to divest its BioPharma Solutions business to Advent International and Warburg Pincus for $4.25 billion
deals.summary: Advent and Warburg Pincus agreed to buy Baxter's BioPharma Solutions CDMO business (later Simtra BioPharma Solutions) for $4.25 billion in cash.
deals.evidence: Deerfield, Ill., Boston, Mass., and New York, N.Y. – May 8, 2023 – Baxter International Inc. (NYSE:BAX), a leading global medtech company, today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement to divest its BioPharma Solutions (“BPS”) business to Advent International (“Advent”), one of the largest and most experienced global private equity investors, and Warburg Pincus, a leading global growth investor. Under the terms of the definitive agreement, Baxter will receive $4.25 billion in cash, subject to certain closing adjustments, with net after-tax proceeds currently estimated to be approximately $3.4 billion.

deals.headline: Advent International agrees to partial sale of InPost shareholding to PPF Group
deals.summary: Advent agreed to sell a 15% stake in InPost to PPF Group at EUR 10 per share, remaining the largest shareholder with 30.3%.
deals.evidence: London, 26 May 2023 – Advent International (“Advent”), one of the world’s largest and most experienced private equity investors, has agreed to sell part of its shareholding in InPost Group (“InPost” or “the Group”), representing 15% of the Group’s total share capital, for €10 per share to PPF Group (“PPF”), a privately-held international investment company. On completion of the initial sale, Advent will remain the largest shareholder in the Group with a 30.3% ownership stake.

deals.headline: Eurazeo has signed a sale agreement with Advent International on Planet based on a €1.8 billion valuation
deals.summary: Eurazeo agreed to sell its stake in payments company Planet to Advent at a EUR 1.8bn valuation, reinvesting to co-control it with Advent.
deals.evidence: EURAZEO is pleased to announce an agreement for a sale of its stake in integrated payments leader, Planet (« The Company »). As part of the transaction Eurazeo will reinvest and co-control the Company with Advent International (“Advent”). Under this agreement, Planet is valued at €1.8bn.

deals.headline: Assembly surpasses $1B valuation; announces strategic investment led by Advent International
deals.summary: E-commerce software platform Assembly, later the owner of Pacvue, announced a capital injection led by Advent with PSG, valuing it above $1 billion.
deals.evidence: LOS ANGELES , Sept. 21, 2021 /PRNewswire/ -- Assembly, a leading eCommerce software and data platform, today announces a significant capital injection led by Advent International ("Advent"), one of the largest and most experienced global private equity investors. This round, which has boosted Assembly's valuation to north of $1 billion , will be used to continue fueling its growth plans and mission to provide the best software, content and communities that support eCommerce merchants.

deals.headline: Assembly Acquires Pacvue, Enterprise Platform for E-Commerce Advertising, Sales and Intelligence
deals.summary: Advent-backed Assembly acquired e-commerce advertising platform Pacvue.
deals.evidence: LOS ANGELES , Oct. 26, 2021 /PRNewswire/ -- Assembly, the leading e-commerce software and data platform, serving millions of merchants spanning 125 countries, today announced the acquisition of Pacvue, an enterprise-grade marketplace advertising, sales and intelligence platform.

deals.headline: Code Security Firm SonarSource Raises $412 Million at $4.7 Billion Valuation
deals.summary: SonarSource raised $412 million at a $4.7 billion valuation in a round led by Advent and General Catalyst.
deals.evidence: Swiss code quality software firm SonarSource on Tuesday announced a $412 million funding round at a heady valuation of $4.7 billion as investors continue to pour money into startups tackling software supply chain security. SonarSource said the financing was led by new investors Advent International and General Catalyst.

deals.headline: BigPanda Raises $190 Million in Funding at $1.2 Billion Valuation
deals.summary: AIOps company BigPanda raised $190 million at a $1.2 billion valuation in a round led by Advent and Insight Partners.
deals.evidence: SAN FRANCISCO, Jan. 12, 2022 — BigPanda, Inc. , the leader in AIOps Event Correlation and Automation, today cemented its leadership position in the AIOps market with a new $190 million funding round. This financing round was led by Advent International, through its dedicated technology fund, and New York-based global venture capital and private equity firm Insight Partners, with participation by other existing investors.

deals.headline: Coralogix raises $142 million to expand its offerings into further markets
deals.summary: Observability platform Coralogix raised a $142 million Series D co-led by Advent and Brighton Park Capital.
deals.evidence: Coralogix announced it has raised a $142 million Series D funding round, bringing the company’s total amount raised to $238 million. New investors Advent International (“Advent”) and Brighton Park Capital (“Brighton Park”) co-led the round with participation from Revaia Ventures and existing investors Greenfield Partners, Red Dot Capital Partners, Eyal Ofer’s O.G. Tech, StageOne Ventures, Joule Capital Partners, and Maor Investments.

deals.headline: Seedtag raises over €250M from Advent International
deals.summary: Contextual advertising company Seedtag raised over EUR 250 million from Advent; Oakley Capital, Adara and All Iron Ventures remained investors.
deals.evidence: Seedtag, the leader in contextual advertising in EMEA and LATAM, has today announced that it has raised over €250M in funding from private equity investor Advent International. As part of the transaction, Seedtag’s core existing institutional investors - Oakley Capital, Adara and All Iron Ventures – will remain investors, supporting the company in its next phase of growth.

deals.headline: Advent buys MANGOPAY, doles out €75 million to fuel expansion beyond Europe
deals.summary: Advent acquired marketplace payments provider MANGOPAY from Crédit Mutuel Arkéa (which kept a minority stake) and injected EUR 75 million of primary capital.
deals.evidence: Paris-based provider of payment solutions to e-commerce sites, MANGOPAY has been acquired by US-based private equity investor Advent . The change of hands will see Advent injecting €75 million of primary capital.

deals.headline: Carlyle, Advent buy 9.99% stake in Yes Bank, to pump in about Rs 8,896 cr
deals.summary: Carlyle and Advent each took a 9.99% stake in YES Bank, together investing about Rs 8,896 crore with full conversion of warrants.
deals.evidence: Yes Bank on Tuesday said private equity majors Carlyle Group and Advent have picked up 9.99 per cent stake in the bank. The two private equity (PE) funds together would pump in about Rs 8,896 crore in Yes Bank with full conversion of warrants into equity.

deals.headline: PE major Advent International buys majority stake in Eureka Forbes
deals.summary: Advent agreed to acquire a majority stake in Eureka Forbes from Shapoorji Pallonji Group at an enterprise valuation of Rs 4,400 crore, with an open offer to follow.
deals.evidence: Private equity major Advent International on Sunday signed an agreement with Shapoorji Pallonji Group to acquire a majority stake in Eureka Forbes at an enterprise valuation of Rs 4,400 crore.

deals.headline: Advent International acquires a minority interest in Spend Management Leader Medius
deals.summary: Advent acquired a minority stake in source-to-pay software provider Medius; Marlin Equity Partners remained majority shareholder.
deals.evidence: STOCKHOLM , March 16, 2022 /PRNewswire/ -- Medius , a leading provider of source to pay solutions, today announced that global private equity firm Advent International has acquired a minority stake in the business. Following the deal, Marlin Equity Partners remains Medius' majority shareholder.

deals.headline: Goldman Sachs Asset Management to sell Caldic to Advent International
deals.summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management agreed to sell specialty chemicals distributor Caldic to Advent, which planned to combine it with portfolio company GTM.
deals.evidence: Rotterdam, 22 November 2021 – Goldman Sachs Asset Management today announced it has reached a conditional agreement to sell Caldic BV (“Caldic”) to Advent International (“Advent”).

deals.headline: Advent International acquires stake in Imperial Dade, which continues to expand in Canada and Midwest
deals.summary: Advent agreed to acquire a significant stake in distributor Imperial Dade from Bain Capital, with joint board governance.
deals.evidence: Advent International of Boston on Monday said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire a significant stake in Imperial Dade from Bain Capital Private Equity .

deals.headline: Carlyle to sell IRCA to Advent
deals.summary: Advent agreed to acquire Italian pastry and gelato ingredients maker IRCA from Carlyle.
deals.evidence: Advent International has agreed to acquire IRCA, an Italian producer of specialty ingredients for artisanal pastries, cakes and gelatos, from Carlyle.

deals.headline: Web3 and blockchain security startup CertiK raises $88M at $2B valuation
deals.summary: Web3 security firm CertiK raised $88 million in a Series B3 led by Insight Partners with Tiger Global, Advent and Goldman Sachs, at a $2 billion valuation.
deals.evidence: CertiK, a cybersecurity startup focused on the Web3 and blockchain ecosystem, today announced that it has raised $88 million from investors three months after closing its previous funding round. CertiK’s Series B3 funding round was led by Insight Partners. Tiger Global, Advent International and Goldman Sachs participated along with existing backers. The investment values CertiK at $2 billion, more than double the valuation that the startup received after its previous funding round three months ago.

deals.headline: Salt Security reaches $1.4 billion valuation in $140 million Series D
deals.summary: API security company Salt Security raised a $140 million Series D led by CapitalG at a $1.4 billion valuation, with existing investor Advent participating.
deals.evidence: API security company Salt Security announced on Thursday that it raised $140 million in Series D funding, led by CapitalG, Alphabet’s independent growth fund. The latest investment brings the valuation of Salt Security to $1.4 billion. All the investors who have backed Salt Security in previous rounds also participated in this raise, including Sequoia Capital, Y Combinator, Tenaya Capital, S Capital VC, Advent International, Alkeon Capital, and DFJ Growth.

deals.headline: HYPR Raises Another $35M for its Passwordless Multi-Factor Authentication Platform
deals.summary: Passwordless authentication company HYPR raised a $35 million Series C led by Advent.
deals.evidence: This is a $35M Series C Investment led by Advent International. Advent joins HYPR’s existing investors including RRE Ventures, .406 Ventures, BoldStart, Top Tier Capital, MESH, Alumni Ventures Group, Allen & Co, Samsung NEXT, and Mastercard .

deals.headline: Cyware Announces $30M Series B Funding Led by Advent International and Ten Eleven Ventures
deals.summary: Cyber fusion platform Cyware raised a $30 million Series B led by Advent Tech and Ten Eleven Ventures.
deals.evidence: NEW YORK , March 16, 2021 /PRNewswire/ -- Cyware , the industry's only Virtual Cyber Fusion platform provider, today announced that it raised $30 million in Series B funding. The round was led by Advent International through Advent Tech, as well as Ten Eleven Ventures, with participation from previous investors, including the Prelude Fund (the venture practice at Mercato Partners), Emerald Development Managers, Great Road Holdings and Zscaler.

deals.headline: BigID Welcomes $30M Investment from Advent International, Valuing BigID at $1.25B
deals.summary: BigID took a $30 million investment from Advent Tech, extending its Series D and valuing the company at $1.25 billion.
deals.evidence: NEW YORK and TEL AVIV, Israel , April 22, 2021 /PRNewswire/ -- BigID , a leader in data discovery and intelligence for privacy, protection and perspective, today announced a $30 million investment from Advent International, one of the largest and most experienced global private equity investors, through Advent Tech, extending the company's $70 million Series D financing raised in December 2020 . This latest financing brings BigID's valuation to $1.25 billion .

deals.headline: Wiz becomes fastest growing security startup ever with new $1.7B valuation
deals.summary: Cloud security company Wiz raised a $130 million Series B led by Advent Tech at a $1.7 billion valuation.
deals.evidence: Advent International through Advent Tech led the round. Joining Advent International (Bryan Taylor and Alek Ferro) in the round is Greenoaks (Neil Mehta and Patrick Backhouse) along with our existing investors from Index Ventures (Shardul Shah), Sequoia Capital (Doug Leone and Bogomil Balkansky), Insight (Jeff Horing) and Cyberstarts (Gili Ranaan). With the $100M Series A from December 2020 and the $130M Series B today, we have eliminated that barrier and are poised to be the leader in cloud infrastructure security.

deals.headline: Avio and Advent Enter into an Investment Agreement to Accelerate Growth
deals.summary: Space propulsion company Avio agreed a capital increase reserved for Advent, which will take about 7% at EUR 33.40 per share for up to EUR 109.4 million.
deals.evidence: Under the Agreement, Advent will acquire a stake equal to approximately 7% of Avio's share capital on a pre-money basis. With reference to such acquisition, Avio's Board of Directors will resolve - in execution of the delegated power granted the Board of Directors, pursuant to Article 2443 of the Italian Civil Code, by Avio's extraordinary shareholders meeting on October 23, 2025 - a share capital increase to be carried out through the issuance of maximum no. 3,275,268 shares, representing a pre-money stake equal to approximately 7% of the share capital of Avio to be reserved for subscription to Advent according to art. 2441, paragraph 4, second sentence, of the Italian Civil Code, at a share price equal to Euro 33.40, for a total amount of maximum Euro 109,393,951.20.

deals.headline: Quantum Systems Raises $1.2Bn Series D to Accelerate Multi-Domain Autonomy
deals.summary: German drone maker Quantum Systems signed a $1.2 billion Series D co-led by Blackstone, Noteus, Airbus and Advent at about $8 billion post-money.
deals.evidence: Quantum Systems today announced the signing of its $1.2 billion Series D financing round, valuing the company at ~ $8 billion on a post-money basis. The round was co-led by Blackstone, Noteus, Airbus and Advent, and supported by a high-calibre syndicate of crossover and long-term institutional investors including BOND, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Wellington Management, A.P. Moller Holding, and Elephant Lake Ventures, as well as existing shareholders such as Balderton and HV Capital.

deals.headline: Stark bags €500M in new funding
deals.summary: German defence drone maker Stark confirmed a EUR 500 million funding round whose investors include Sequoia, Founders Fund, the NATO Innovation Fund and Advent.
deals.evidence: Stark , the German defence tech startup which makes weaponised drones, has today confirmed it has raised €500 million in new funding. Sequoia, Peter Thiel's Founders Fund, the NATO Innovation Fund, Project A, Air Street Capital, 201 Ventures, Advent and Döpfner Capital are amongst the investors in the round, it said.

deals.headline: Advent takes 8% stake in Natura to back turnaround
deals.summary: Advent built a 6.6% stake in Brazilian beauty company Natura, rising to 8% on conversion of derivatives, under a March 2026 agreement with Natura's founders.
deals.evidence: U.S. private equity firm Advent International has built a stake in Natura after acquiring 6.6% of the Brazilian beauty company’s shares. The holding will increase to 8% following the conversion of derivative instruments equivalent to another 1.4% of the company’s stock held by the investment firm. At the time, the company said the fund would acquire between 8% and 10% of Natura at an average share price of R$9.75 over six months.

deals.headline: Advent to acquire Sapiens for $2.5bn
deals.summary: Advent agreed to take insurance software provider Sapiens private for $43.50 per share in cash, an equity value of about $2.5 billion.
deals.evidence: Advent, a leading global private equity investor, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Sapiens International Corporation N.V., a provider of software solutions for the insurance industry, for $43.50 per common share, in an all-cash transaction that values Sapiens at an equity value of approximately $2.5 billion.

deals.headline: Private equity group Advent to buy U-Blox for $1.3 billion
deals.summary: Advent agreed to take over Swiss positioning-chip maker u-blox in a cash offer worth CHF 1.05 billion.
deals.evidence: Private equity group Advent International has agreed to take over Switzerland's U-Blox Holding in a cash offer worth CHF1.05 billion ($1.30 billion).

deals.headline: InPost to be taken private in €7.8bn FedEx-backed deal
deals.summary: InPost agreed to a recommended EUR 15.60-per-share take-private by a consortium of Advent, FedEx, founder Rafał Brzoska's A&R and PPF, with Advent and FedEx at 37% each.
deals.evidence: Parcel locker operator InPost has agreed to a recommended all-cash takeover that will see the company taken private in a €7.8bn ($9.3bn) deal led by private equity group Advent International and FedEx. Under the proposed transaction, a consortium comprising Advent, FedEx, InPost founder Rafał Brzoska’s investment vehicle A&R, and existing shareholder PPF will acquire all outstanding InPost shares for €15.60 per share, a premium of about 50% on the company’s undisturbed share price. Following completion, the consortium will be split between Advent and FedEx with 37% each, alongside A&R with 16% and PPF with 10%.

deals.headline: Advent International and CEMEX partner to accelerate development of NEORIS
deals.summary: Advent agreed to acquire a 65% stake in IT consultancy NEORIS from CEMEX, which retained 35%.
deals.evidence: As part of the creation of the partnership, Advent will acquire from CEMEX a 65% stake in NEORIS. CEMEX will retain a 35% stake and remain as a key strategic partner and customer of NEORIS, supporting CEMEX’s efforts to provide a superior customer experience enabled by digital technologies.

deals.headline: EPAM to Acquire NEORIS
deals.summary: EPAM agreed to acquire IT consultancy NEORIS from Advent-managed funds and Cemex.
deals.evidence: (NYSE: EPAM), a leading digital transformation services and product engineering company, announced today that it has entered into an agreement to acquire NEORIS , a Miami -headquartered global advanced technology consultancy with more than 4,700 professionals across major talent hubs in Latin America , Spain and the U.S. The sellers are funds managed by Advent International, one of the largest and most experienced global private equity investors, and Cemex, a global construction materials company.

deals.headline: Advent International and GHL Hotels Agree to Form a Partnership to Accelerate GHL’s Growth in Latin America
deals.summary: Advent agreed to invest in Latin American third-party hotel operator GHL Hotels to support its regional expansion.
deals.evidence: BOGOTÁ, May 3, 2022 – Advent International (“Advent”), one of the largest and most experienced global private equity investors, and GHL Hotels (“GHL”), one of the largest third-party hotel operator in the region, part of GHL Group, today announced that they have agreed to enter into a partnership, whereby Advent will invest in GHL and support its expansion across Latin America.

deals.headline: KreditBee enters unicorn club with $280 Mn Series E round
deals.summary: Digital lender KreditBee raised a $280 million Series E at a $1.5 billion post-money valuation, led by Motilal Oswal Alternates, Hornbill and Dragon Funds, with Advent participating.
deals.evidence: Digital lending platform KreditBee has raised $280 million in its Series E round at a post-money valuation of $1.5 billion. The round was led by Motilal Oswal Alternates, Hornbill Capital, and MUFG-backed Dragon Funds. WhiteOak Capital, A.P. Moller Holding, Premji Invest, and Advent International also participated.

deals.headline: Advent to acquire Cobham for $5bn
deals.summary: Advent agreed to acquire UK aerospace and defence group Cobham for 165 pence per share in cash, valuing it at about $5bn.
deals.evidence: In a deal that values the UK defence and aerospace group at $5bn, Cobham Plc is to be acquired by US private equity (PE) firm Advent International. Under the terms of the acquisition, Cobham shareholders will receive 165 pence in cash for each Cobham share, representing a premium of approximately 34.4 percent.

deals.headline: 75% of Hermes UK and Germany to be sold by Otto Group
deals.summary: Advent agreed with Otto Group to acquire 75% of Hermes UK (later Evri) and 25% of Hermes Germany.
deals.evidence: Under the terms of the deal, Advent will partner with the current management team to acquire a 75% stake in Hermes UK. In addition to the 75% shareholding in Hermes UK, Advent will also acquire a 25% stake in Hermes Germany, which includes other Hermes Germany Group companies including BorderGuru and a share in the ParcelLock joint venture.

deals.headline: 75% of Hermes UK and Germany to be sold by Otto Group
deals.summary: As part of its Hermes partnership with Otto Group, Advent agreed to acquire a 25% stake in Hermes Germany.
deals.evidence: In addition to the 75% shareholding in Hermes UK, Advent will also acquire a 25% stake in Hermes Germany, which includes other Hermes Germany Group companies including BorderGuru and a share in the ParcelLock joint venture.

deals.headline: Dufry raises CHF820 million through capital increase; Alibaba Group builds shareholding
deals.summary: In Dufry's CHF 820 million rights offering, 9,178,033 new shares were allocated to Advent, leaving it with an 11.4% stake.
deals.evidence: 10,612,024 new shares were subscribed by existing shareholders as part of the rights offering, 9,178,033 new shares have been allocated to Advent International and 4,906,459 new shares have been allocated to Alibaba Group, corresponding to the maximum possible total of 24,696,516 new shares sold in the offering. Immediately following the closing of the offering, Advent International will own a stake of 11.4% in Dufry and Alibaba Group 6.1%.

deals.headline: PE firm Advent acquires API maker RA Chem Pharma from Micro Labs
deals.summary: Advent agreed to acquire a controlling stake in API maker RA Chem Pharma (later part of Cohance) from Micro Labs.
deals.evidence: US-based private equity investor Advent International on July 30 said it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire a controlling stake in RA Chem Pharma, a vertically integrated pharmaceutical company from Micro Labs.

deals.headline: PE firm Advent International acquires majority stake in Bharat Serums & Vaccines
deals.summary: Advent agreed to acquire a majority interest in Bharat Serums and Vaccines, with the founding Daftary family retaining a meaningful stake.
deals.evidence: US-based global private equity firm Advent International November 18 said it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire a majority interest in Bharat Serums and Vaccines (BSV). The Daftary family, which founded BSV, is retaining a meaningful equity stake in the business and partnering with Advent on the company’s next stage of growth.

deals.headline: Advent International to acquire 68pc in DFM Foods; launches open offer for 26%
deals.summary: Advent agreed to buy 67.9% of Crax snack maker DFM Foods from its promoters for about Rs 851.6 crore and launched an open offer for 26%.
deals.evidence: New Delhi, Sep 9 () US-based private equity firm Advent International Corporation has entered into a pact with the promoters of DFM Foods, which sells snacks under the Crax and the Natkhat brands, to acquire 67.9 per cent stake in the Delhi-based firm for around Rs 851.6 crore in an all cash deal.

deals.headline: Thrasio Reaches $1B Valuation, Sets New US Speed Record for Unicorns
deals.summary: Amazon aggregator Thrasio raised a $260 million Series C led by Advent at a $1 billion pre-money valuation.
deals.evidence: BOSTON and NEW YORK , July 15, 2020 /PRNewswire/ -- Thras.io, Inc. (" Thrasio "), the largest acquirer of Amazon businesses and one of the top 25 sellers on Amazon, today announced that it has raised $260 million in a Series C financing led by Advent International, one of the largest and most experienced global private equity investors. The latest round was raised at a $1 billion pre-money valuation, making Thrasio the fastest US company ever to reach profitable unicorn status 1 .

deals.headline: Silver Lake Leads Thrasio's $1 Billion Series D Financing Alongside Advent International, Upper90, and PEAK6
deals.summary: Thrasio announced an initial close of more than $1 billion in Series D funding led by Silver Lake with existing largest shareholder Advent.
deals.evidence: BOSTON , Oct. 25, 2021 /PRNewswire/ -- Thrasio Holdings, Inc. (" Thrasio ") today announced the initial closing of more than $1 billion in Series D financing led by Silver Lake, the global leader in technology investing, together with existing investor Advent International, which remains Thrasio's largest shareholder. Existing investors Upper90, funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, L.P., PEAK6 Investments and Corner Capital also participated in the round.

deals.headline: Tech-Enabled PBO RxBenefits Reaches $1.1B Valuation After Recapitalization
deals.summary: Advent completed a recapitalization of pharmacy benefits optimizer RxBenefits valuing it at about $1.1 billion, now owning an equal stake with Great Hill Partners.
deals.evidence: Advent International (“Advent”), one of the largest and most experienced global private equity investors, today announced that it has completed a recapitalization of RxBenefits , the employee benefits industry’s first and only technology-enabled pharmacy benefits optimizer (PBO) , which values the company at approximately $1.1 billion. Advent and Great Hill now each own equal stakes in RxBenefits, alongside a significant investment from the current management team.

deals.headline: Nubank acquires Easynvest to launch into investment market
deals.summary: Nubank announced the acquisition of Advent-backed Brazilian brokerage Easynvest.
deals.evidence: Today (11), the unicorn announced its acquisition of São Paulo-based Easynvest , a brokerage platform with 1.5 million customers and a reported R$20 billion (~US$ 3.8 billion) in assets under management.
